Maya (CSM): @Ethan hey 4b6 kicking off Thrive onboarding. Goal: get search + rerank flows into staging and a demo-ready demo by day 21. Proposed kickoff Thu 05/02 11:00 PT. Please confirm stakeholders and any compliance flags.
Ethan (Thrive PM): Thu works. Stakeholders: me (PM), Nora (Backend), Marco (SRE), Priya (Security). Compliance: GDPR data handling mostly; Priya will want retention details.
Leo (Impl Eng): I'll assemble the peering checklist + minimal firewall rules. ETA: Wed EOD. Will include a curl sanity test.
Sofia (Solutions Eng): I'll own smoke tests and perf targets: p95 text-gen < 300ms single-client baseline, embeddings median <1.8s at 64 batch. Also will run a 3-min 30RPS burst to observe caching.
Ivy (Success Ops): Enablement plan: 30-min weekly syncs for 3 weeks + a 1hr deep-dive in week2. I'll create invites and a 3-question feedback form to capture early friction.
Maya (CSM): Action items: Leo (peering checklist, Wed), Sofia (perf plan + thresholds, before kickoff), Ivy (invites + feedback form, by Mon), Ethan (confirm test-account + sample traffic by Wed). I'll post the kickoff invite and attach the onboarding playbook.
onboarding-bot: Onboarding page created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/THRIVE-3070011111 (checklist + SOW excerpt).
Ethan (Thrive PM): I'll add an anonymized 24h traffic sample and drop Priya's notes on retention. See you Thu.
